text_block_list.text:
Two days have passed since the tryout
races.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow, I'll have to prove myself to
Симболи Рудольф. I'm walking
around,
racking my brain for ideas, and then...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh. Hello again, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Wait! You're the trainer who was speaking
to Rudolf in the cafeteria
the other day,
right?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
Haha! When a trainer has a meal with
someone of Rudolf's caliber
right after the
tryouts, word's bound to get out!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
Heh... I guess we attracted more attention
than either of us could
have expected.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You and Rudolf seem close... Would you
mind if I asked a favor of
you?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
Could you stay by Rudolf's side today and
take some candid shots of
her?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A
choice_data_list: You want me to take photos?

text_block_list.text:
My apologies for dragging you into this.
They want to do an "up close
and
personal" feature with me, you see.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The only problem is, when I'm surrounded
by professional reporters, I
end up acting
professional myself.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I was at my wit's end, wondering what to
do—and that's when you
happened to
arrive.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Rudolf will be able to relax if she's
around you! Please help
us out!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
Wait, you mean it? You... really do go the
extra mile.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
In that case, I look forward to our day
together.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And so I take the camera from the reporter
and prepare to spend the
day taking
candid snaps of Симболи Рудольф.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now then. According to the journalist, I
should ignore the camera and
go about my
daily routine.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
There's a new student I'm concerned
about. I have an idea to help her
better
adjust to life here.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Shall we?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Ah. I've been looking for you, Марузенски.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Well, hello, Rudolf! And hello to you too,
trainer.♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
So, what brings you here? Anything I can
help you with?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Yes, actually. I was hoping you could help
me with a first-year named
Grass Wonder.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер! Yes, I know her. She's an
absolute sweetie—and so
polite! What
about her?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
It might be because she's not accustomed
to the academy's track yet,
but she's
having a bit of trouble with her technique
coming out of the
gate.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Is that so? Well, it does take a while to adjust, especially when you're in a brand-new environment.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I don't want her to fall before she's even
had a chance to fly. Could
you perhaps
give her some words of wisdom?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Sure, I can give her some pointers, but...
why me, if you don't mind me
asking?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер... The explosive burst of
energy she puts forth when
she runs
reminds me somewhat of you.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
That's why I figured you'd be in the best
position to help her.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
That makes sense. You really do look out
for all of us, don't you?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I'm totally down, leave it to me! Do you
know where Grass is?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I always appreciate the enthusiasm,
Марузенски. I can take you to her
now, if
you like.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф leads the way to Grass
Wonder.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, no. She looks so down in the dumps.
But I'm on it! I'll turn her
frown upside
down!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I knew I could count on you. I leave this
matter in your capable hands,
Марузенски.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Having me there would make Grass
Wonder nervous. That's the last
thing I
want for her.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Personally, I think she'd be happy to know
you're looking out for her.
Hehe, but I like
this awkward side of you too.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Anyway, I'm off.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
That's that, then. I hope speaking with
Марузенски can alleviate
Grass Wonder's
worries.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: You really know the student body.

text_block_list.text:
Well, for Грасс Вандер... I know she lived
in the US for a while. She
has a gentle
outward demeanor that belies an adamant
will within.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
She runs as a late surger, using
cool-headed observation skills to
keenly
assess the field and seize victory with
precision. I expect she'll
go on to do great
things
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And it's not just her. Every student here
enters the academy with their
own dreams
and hopes. Every one of them has the
potential to make
them come true.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I... wish to make them all happy. I can't
help but feel it's my duty to
create a world
where all of them can wear smiles.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Does this sound like the foolish dream of a
sheltered girl? Perhaps
that's just what it
is.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It goes without saying the road to
achieving my goal is long, with no
end in
sight, but...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Thank you, Марузенски. I... have been putting myself under a lot of pressure, haven't I?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
That's right. You're quite serious, and you
always give everything one
hundo p!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
But trying to please everyone all the time
will wear you down. Why
don't we chillax
and go for a drive sometime?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
That sounds wonderful! Hehe... It would be
my honor! ♪
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Look at her smile.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I hope its warmth never fades... Of that, at
least, I have no doubt.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Something about Симболи Рудольф's own
warm smile tugs at my heart.
It's such a
peaceful, contented expression.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Almost without thinking, I raise the
camera, and...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Click.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What a beautiful shot. As the shutter
clicks, I also feel something
click into
place within me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I think I finally have the answer to Symboli
Rudolf's question.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
